// Blood II's laser beams, as Mod\Lasers.txt sets them.  GENERATED by
// `testBlood2Tables --dump lasers` from Blood2/Shared/BloodModLasers.cpp,
// which transcribes ClientShellDLL/LaserBeamFX.cpp's SetupBeam; do not
// edit, regenerate.
//
// A section is a LASER_ name without the prefix.  A beam grows from
// MinScale to MaxScale over ScaleTime, fades over FadeTime and is gone
// after Duration.  A mod names only what it changes:
//
//     [YELLOW_SMALL]
//     Duration = 0.015625
//
// Blood2/Shared/BloodModLasers.h has the rest.
